verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own data-import capabilities: free spreadsheet import, a Bulk Write API that inserts or upserts up to 25,000 records per call with job-completion callbacks, and an option to skip workflow triggers during inserts. These cover moving record data in, but nothing shows a dedicated CRM-to-CRM migration path, record-owner mapping, or preservation of activity history and timestamps. Missing for 10: a documented migration wizard or connectors for other CRMs, owner/user mapping during import, preservation of notes/activities/history, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full migration.
